metadata.description: Comprehensive SEO analysis plugin for Claude Code. 26 sub-skills and 19 sub-agents, plus 9 optional MCP extensions for live data. v2.4.2 adds seo-cockpit (a mods companion: spend guard, live audit band, and a visual cockpit) and Google sign-in through your own gcloud account; v2.4.1 brought Google guidance current through 2026-09-28; v2.4.0 added /seo agentic for agent readiness (Lighthouse Agentic Browsing, WebMCP, AI agent access).
